verifier: session 28cc78aa (direct fetch of each official source)

facts.quote: (a) Touchdown: 6 points
(b) Field goal: 3 points
(c) Safety: 2 points
(d) Try after touchdown: 1 point (field goal or safety) or 2 points (touchdown)
the extra point will now be kicked from the 15-yard line with two-point conversions remaining at the 2-yard line
(c) two yards from the defensive team's goal line for a Try by pass or run
The new rule also gives the defense the ability to score two points on returns.
The length of the game is 60 minutes, divided into four periods of 15 minutes each.
Between the second and third periods, there shall be an intermission of 13 minutes.

facts.fact: Players per team on the field
facts.quote: The game is played by two teams of 11 players each.

facts.value: 360 ft x 160 ft; goal lines 10 yd from end lines
facts.quote: a rectangular field, 360 feet in length and 160 feet in width ... Goal lines shall be established in the field 10 yards from and parallel to each end line.

facts.value: One 10-minute period; both teams must have an opportunity to possess (except safety on opening possession); tie possible
facts.quote: Both teams must have the opportunity to possess the ball once during the extra period, unless the team kicking off ... scores a safety on the receiving team's initial possession

facts.value: 15-minute periods until a winner; both teams must have an opportunity to possess
facts.quote: play will continue, regardless of how many 15-minute periods are necessary

facts.value: Approved April 1, 2025 at the Annual Meeting (proposal 2-A by Philadelphia)
facts.quote: aligns the postseason and regular season overtime rules by granting both teams an opportunity to possess the ball regardless of the outcome of the first possession, subject to a 10-minute overtime period in the regular season
NFL owners voted Tuesday to approve an enhanced schedule which will feature 17 regular-season games per team
14-team playoff: Starting in the 2020 season, seven teams from each conference will make the playoffs

facts.value: 48 players (up from 46); at least 8 offensive linemen
facts.quote: The number of active players on gameday will increase to 48 players from 46.

facts.value: 53 players (2025 bylaw allows 2 return designations at cutdown)
facts.quote: to permit clubs to designate two players for return at the roster reduction to 53 players

facts.value: Permanent from 2025; touchback to the 35 when ball lands in end zone and is downed / out of bounds behind goal line
facts.quote: make permanent the new form of free kick play implemented in 2024 ... changes the dead ball spot after a touchback to the 35-yard line

facts.value: Setup-zone alignment modified (6-1-3); touchback spot modified for kickoffs from the 50 (6-1-5); onside kick may be declared at any time (6-1-6)
facts.quote: 6-1-6 Permits the kicking team to declare an onside kick at any time during the game.

facts.fact: Regular-season games can end tied after OT
facts.value: Yes — tie stands if still level after the single 10-minute OT period
facts.quote: If the score is tied at the end of the period, the game shall result in a tie.
